title: Where to Invest ₹10 Lacs Now Across Stock Market, Gold & FDs | Rahul Jain G2G
creator: Rahul Jain
summary: Rahul Jain hosts SEBI-registered, fee-only adviser Amit Kukreja (Amit Kukreja Advisory, Gurugram) on the Good to Great podcast to answer where to put ₹10 lakh now across equities, gold and FDs. Kukreja calls the last 2–2.5 years choppy — Nifty swinging roughly 22,000–26,000 after peaking at 26,179 on 27 September 2024 — with drivers external (war, crude, inflation, RBI rates, rupee near ₹96/$), so he expects no stability for 9–12 months and will not call the worst over. His core advice is a minimum five-year horizon, keep SIPs running, and judge each SIP purchase separately, since recent purchases already show gains. Tactically he prefers large-cap and flexi-cap funds (large caps attractively valued, mid-caps next, small caps least preferred), with banking/financials, consumption, healthcare/pharma and infrastructure as pillars, and AI-adopting technology as conditional — on TCS he explicitly gives no recommendation, noting 1–2% constant-currency growth against a strong AI pipeline and advising investors to wait. For a conservative investor he illustrates 50% equity / 10% gold / 40% fixed income, versus 80/10/10 for aggressive investors; gold should be held at about 10% and topped up when its share falls below that, not chased after doubling. He also endorses passive global index exposure, staggering a ₹10 lakh deployment over four weeks to six months depending on its share of total wealth, and avoiding panic exits, FOMO, margin trading and loans for investing. No explicit calls — no individual stock gets a BUY/SELL/HOLD with a stated ₹ price; allocations are general guidance. Captions are clean.
